### Day 246: Acts 14:1–7
Author: Beth Moore  
Site: Crosswalk  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-246-acts-14-17.html  
Passage: Acts 14:1-7  
Points:  
- Paul and Barnabas preached boldly and saw miracles, yet united opposition plotted to stone them.  
- Instead of confronting their attackers, the missionaries chose to run for safety.  
- Fleeing imminent danger demonstrated practical wisdom and prudence rather than cowardice or doubt.  
- Jesus similarly withdrew from hostile crowds whenever His appointed hour had not yet arrived.  
- God often rescues His servants through ordinary, natural means rather than spectacular interventions.
